text:
Morgan: quick notes from today's failover rehearsal (us-west-2 -> eu-west-1). ran ~35m with AZ drains. three repeatable issues found -- owners and next steps below.

Sam: saw transient 502s during route weight flips. looks like sticky cookie TTL != shim cache TTL, plus connection draining wasn't enforced.

Sam: plan: implement graceful drain in shim, add 2s post-drain stabilization, and run a canary rollout (1% -> 5% -> 25%). ETA canary start 2027-03-02T18:00Z. will upload rollout JSON.

Priya: backup manifest problem: nightly snapshot manifest referenced shards not present in storage index. root cause: concurrent compaction + manifest writer race.

Priya: mitigation: add manifest write lock + post-write validation that fails and alerts. patch to staging by 2027-03-03, promote after 48h. JIRA INFRA-3247 opened.

Ashley: runbook gap: DNS flip step didn't wait for control-plane replication; caused split-writes for ~30s.

Ashley: will PR runbook edits to add a pre-flip verification gate (replication lag, KV checkpoint sync, quorum health). ETA PR 2027-03-04.

NetOps: we'll add a drain hook to the BGP weight script, review scheduled 2027-03-03.

infra-bot: pipeline queued: shim-drain-canary by Sam -> build#4239 started. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/4239

Morgan: action summary: Sam (shim drain + canary, ETA 2027-03-02), Priya (manifest lock + validation, ETA 2027-03-03), Ashley (runbook PR + checklist, ETA 2027-03-04), NetOps (BGP drain hook review 2027-03-03). mini-game-day scheduled 2027-03-10 16:00 UTC (monthly recurring).

Sam: accepted. coordinating with NetOps.

Priya: accepted. monitoring alerts will post to PD if validation fails.

Ashley: accepted. will post PR link here when ready.

Morgan: please flag blockers in-thread. thanks everyone.
